dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent O-shaped and C-shaped structures are visible with irregular, high-intensity perimeters. The pixel gradient transitions from high-intensity white/light-grey at the edges to low-intensity dark-grey within the interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of solid high-intensity pixels lacking internal gradients are distributed between the macro-annuli. Density is highest in the mid-dorsal region, where clusters aggregate into tight, asymmetrical groupings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-body annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. An additional four-point constellation of smaller high-intensity blobs in the anterior region forms an irregular quadrilateral.
